"3D Cartoon Platform Adventure Game

Create a colorful 3D platforming adventure inspired by classic mascot platform games.

Gameplay

- Third-person camera following the player.
- Responsive character movement.
- Running, jumping, spinning, and sliding.
- Enemies that can be defeated using attacks.
- Breakable crates containing collectibles.
- TNT and Nitro crates that create hazards.
- Checkpoints and lives.
- Hidden pathways and secret collectibles.
- Challenging platforming sections.

Level Design

Create multiple themed worlds containing individual levels. Each level should have unique obstacles, enemies, collectibles, and a final exit.

Include jungle environments, ancient ruins, snowy mountains, volcanoes, industrial factories, and castles.

Visual Style

Use colorful cartoon graphics, exaggerated animations, expressive characters, vibrant environments, and humorous visual effects.

Game Structure

- Main menu.
- Playable character selection.
- World selection screen.
- Individual levels.
- Collectible tracking.
- Death and respawn system.
- Level completion screen.
- Boss encounters at the end of major worlds.

Important

The game must be genuinely playable, not just a visual demonstration. Implement working movement, collision detection, attacks, enemies, collectibles, hazards, checkpoints, and level progression.

Use original characters, names, environments, and assets rather than copying copyrighted game assets.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
